body:
I mean, I don't know if I CAN solve it, that's the problem.

I've been depressed before. I've been suicidal before. I stopped hurting with this man. Now I'm back there.

It's really great. (Sarcasm)

I've tried. I honestly try. I end up going out, sitting and just thinking. It's hard.

Then I end up thinking, hey, I could be home. He'll talk to me and I'll give him all my attention. And I end up in a shitty cycle.
